examples.explanation: Subset sums of [1,3] cover 1, 3 and 4. Patching in 2 extends coverage to every value 1..6.
Patching 2 and then 4 (one workable choice) fills the gaps so that 1..20 all become reachable.

hints: Track `miss`, the smallest value not yet known to be formable; initially everything below `miss` is covered.
If the next array element is at most `miss`, absorb it (coverage grows to miss + nums[i]); otherwise patch `miss` itself, doubling coverage.
Count patches until `miss` exceeds n; use 64-bit integers since coverage can pass 2^31.
